description: This file defines the final class 'Recipe' within the Drupal core system, including methods for parsing, validating, and managing recipe configurations for Drupal installation processes.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Final class representing a Drupal recipe, including methods for parsing, validation, and retrieval of recipe data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Recipe class, initializing all recipe properties.

methods.name: createFromDirectory
methods.description: Creates a Recipe object from a directory path by parsing its recipe.yml.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses and validates a recipe.yml file, returning its data as an array.

methods.name: validateDefaultValueDefinition
methods.description: Validates the default value definition for recipe inputs.

methods.name: validateExtensionIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a module or theme extension is available.

methods.name: validateRecipeExists
methods.description: Checks if a referenced recipe exists.

methods.name: validateConfigActions
methods.description: Validates that config actions target installed or available extensions.

methods.name: validateKeysAreValidExtensionNames
methods.description: Validates that array keys are valid extension names.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns extra data exposed to a specific extension.
